# File Icon

**Figma:** icon-media-file (5727:22537, Iconography → Special Icons → File)  
**Import:** `import { FileIcon, fileIconFormatOf } from "@zen/design-system";`

A coloured document mark that identifies a file's type (PDF, sheet, zip, video …) next to its name.

## Use it for
- Uploads (Uploader File-Item Thumbnail=File, 36px).
- Attachments, file lists and table media cells.
- Download lists and recent files.

## Use something else for
- Actions (download, open, attach) → a system Icon (icon-*-line) in a Button.
- App or category marks → DockIcon.
- Image previews → the photo thumbnail itself.

## Figma → React
| Figma | Prop | Values / notes |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Format | `format` | doc · pdf · sheet · zip · photo · video · music · sound · record · figma |
| Pick format | `fileIconFormatOf(nameOrExtension)` | maps .pdf/.xlsx/.mp4… to a format |
| Size | `size` | Icon scale (2xs…3xl) or a number (Uploader uses 36) |
| Title | `title` | names the icon when no file name is shown next to it |

## Props
Generated from the TypeScript source; full JSON in `docs/api/file-icon.json`.

### FileIcon
Figma `icon-media-file` (Iconography → Special Icons → File): a coloured file shape (Content/Support/…/Light, Figma uses Background/Support/Violet/Solid) with an On-Colors glyph. Identifies content types — never an action icon.

| Prop | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `format` (required) | _HTML attribute_ | — | Figma `icon-media-file` Format. |
| `size` | `IconSize \| number` | `"base"` | Same scale as Icon (Element-Size/Popular); Figma draws it at 20 (base). |
| `title` | `string` | — | Accessible name; without it the icon is decorative (the file name usually sits next to it). |

### Types
Object shapes the props above refer to.

```ts
type IconSize = "2xs" | "xs" | "sm" | "base" | "md" | "lg" | "xl" | "2xl" | "3xl"
```

## ✅ Do
- Put it next to the file name in uploads, attachments and lists.
- Pick the format with fileIconFormatOf(file.name) instead of hard-coding.
- Keep one size per list (36 in uploader items, 24–32 in dense lists).

## ❌ Don't
- Don't use it as an action icon or inside a Button (harness: file-icon/not-an-action).
- Don't show a generic doc when a specific format exists.
- Don't recolour it; the base colour encodes the type.

## Accessibility
- Decorative (aria-hidden) when the file name is visible; pass title when it stands alone.

## Harness (`npm run usage:check`)
| Rule | Severity | Checks | Suppress with |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `file-icon/not-an-action` | error | FileIcon identifies a file's type; it is never the icon of a button or action. | `zen-allow-file-icon-action: <reason>` |
| `interaction/no-noop-handler` | warn | Every interaction a Zen control offers works: no no-op handlers (`() => {}`, `() => undefined`), which leave a field that ignores typing and ↑/↓ or a Dismiss that stays. Chat has chat/no-locked-interaction. | `zen-allow-noop-handler: <reason>` |
